programs.what: Sets the phase from a start position set by hand, then walks with the phase held by the encoders until a button is pressed.
programs.checked: compiled to bytecode; imports not resolved

load_with.name: Mindstorms Robot Creator
load_with.steps: Choose an EV3 profile and the pybricks-ev3 target, pick 'Custom (edit below)', paste the file into the editor and use Download .py. Robot Creator does not send programs to an EV3: copy the file to the brick with the alternative below.

programs.form: standalone program; also valid as the customCode body of Robot Creator's code_generate, because it repeats its own imports and makes its own motor objects
programs.alternative: The EV3 MicroPython (Pybricks) microSD image with the LEGO MicroPython extension for VS Code.
